hub.title: Care programs
hub.heading: For conditions you live with
hub.intro: Each program has its own daily log, and it all comes together in your doctor report.
hub.note: These programs don't diagnose; they help you see your doctor with accurate data.

endo.title: Endometriosis
endo.sub: A pain diary with location and intensity
endo.logs: pain location, intensity, type of pain, painkiller effect

pmdd.title: Premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD)
pmdd.sub: A daily mood questionnaire for 2 cycles

heavy_bleeding.title: Heavy bleeding
heavy_bleeding.sub: A bleeding score chart and anaemia risk
heavy_bleeding.logs: number of pads and how soaked they are, clots

pcos.title: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)
pcos.sub: Cycle regularity, skin and hair, weight and blood sugar
pcos.logs: time between periods, acne, unwanted hair, weight

sheet.inactive: You haven't started this program yet.
sheet.joinHint: Starting the program opens its daily log for you. You can leave it any time.
sheet.pcosHint: This program has no form of its own; it uses what you already log (periods, skin and hair, weight).
sheet.leaveHint: Leaving the program doesn't delete what you've logged.

pelvicCard.title: Pelvic floor & bladder
pelvicCard.logs: daily exercise, leaks and night waking

bleeding.title: Bleeding chart

pads.title: Today's pads
pads.hint: Log each pad after changing it, by how soaked it was

bleeding.points: {count, plural, one {{points} point} other {{points} points}} each

alert.title: This period's score is over {threshold}
alert.body: This usually means heavy bleeding. Tell your doctor and ask about an anaemia test (haemoglobin and ferritin).

join.title: Heavy bleeding program
join.body: To log the bleeding chart, start this program first. Your data is only for you and your doctor's report.
join.error: Couldn't start the program. Try again.

pain.title: Pain diary
pain.subtitle: Endometriosis · today
pain.joinTitle: This diary is part of the endometriosis program
pain.joinBody: Start the program to log your pain. You can leave it whenever you like.
pain.whereHint: You can pick more than one
pain.whereNoPain: No pain today — no location needed.
pain.needLocations: For pain above 0, pick where it hurts.
pain.needScore: Pick how bad the pain is.
pain.missed: I couldn't go to work or school
pain.analgesicEmpty: If you took one, add its name and time
pain.scaleNote: 0 means no pain and 10 the worst pain possible. Tell a doctor the same day about severe or sudden pain, fever or fainting.
